moqui.server.JobRegistration.title: Admit to Marketing automations
moqui.server.JobRegistration.description: Files each active automation's new source events (confirmed subscriptions, newly matched segment members, abandoned carts) and admits each eligible person once

moqui.server.RecoveryDescriptor.title: Marketing automations' admission
moqui.server.RecoveryDescriptor.idempotencyNote: Each source event is filed once per automation (a unique source key) and admitted once (one enrollment per automation, person and source): a run again files and admits only what is left.

moqui.service.job.ServiceJob.description: Run the due steps of Marketing automations

moqui.server.JobRegistration.title: Run Marketing automation steps
moqui.server.JobRegistration.description: Runs the due waits, conditions and sends of the active automations' enrollments, rechecking consent, suppression and the goal before each step; a send step hands its participant to the delivery ledger once

moqui.server.RecoveryDescriptor.title: Marketing automations' steps
moqui.server.RecoveryDescriptor.idempotencyNote: Each step of an enrollment runs once (a unique execution per enrollment and step, committed with the enrollment's next step and the send's hand-off) and the ledger answers the delivery it holds for a recipient's key, so a run again repeats nothing.
